purpose: One non-authoritative joined view of historic sanctoral identities, post-1960 saint/group research pool, Doctors roster, 2026 date resolver, and prior user-reviewed painting IDs. Freeze boundaries and reveal exactly what needs canonical cross-owner identity confirmation; do not invent day placements or missing paintings.
scopePolicy: Source rows are distinct stable SOURCE ID KEYS, not a certified count of unique canonized individuals or mandatory artworks.
1962 dated historical components have highest calendar association authority; later canonizations are discovery candidates only and must NOT be auto-added to 1962 Mass/feast.
258 named post-1960 persons are not 258 compulsory individual image subjects; important collective martyr groups use one editorial presentation and no individual-member expansion.
Doctor records are an overlay; IDs with exact overlaps are deduped, non-identical aliases are held until owning Saints/Calendar system certifies them.
Crosswalk between W49 SNT subject IDs and historical stable IDs based on exact transformed *names* is candidate-only, not certified. Never promote these to live art placement/coverage.
W73 human five-star selection is aesthetic approval of a reviewed image, not proof of source image rights, photograph physical original identity, date or production render.
No W49 0-2 banned artwork or excluded artists introduced; all art slots are original-ID leads only.
A calendar day can have several saints or none; 365 calendar dates cannot be the denominator of required individual saint paintings.
Date summary shows historical source occurrences, not actual one-for-one 2026 feast/commemoration final precedence.
No permissions, paid licences, outreach, duplicate canonical saint database or app runtime modifications.

The existing Saints owner has 21 proposed Doctor→historical alias pairs with exact-day/original-sanctoral-source requirements; W74 includes them as read-only leads, not merges. Three source-colour anomalies remain held.
